decision.thesis: No entry. The account is flat, so there is nothing to manage and the only question is whether to open. This run is not late (17 minutes after the slot, 28 to spare), so an entry would have been accepted; every rejection below is on evidence or arithmetic, not on the window. The 00:00 note made SOLUSDT the priority and named its condition precisely: the trade becomes honest only on a fall to the 117.36 shelf THAT HOLDS, with a 117.45 ask and a 117.00 stop giving 2.108 to the 118.9100 target. That condition resolved, and it resolved in the most instructive way available. First, the target is genuine, which was the one thing the note asked to be re-verified: 118.9100 printed on the 15:15Z 5m bar with a 0.447% body against only a 0.261% upper wick - the wick is SMALLER than the body - on 7,985,396 of volume, the heaviest bar of the stretch. It is a real traded high that was rejected, not an artifact, so it stands as a valid overhead reference. Second, the named shelf BROKE. SOL traded below 117.36 at least seven times after the note was written, bottoming at 116.73, so the literal construction is dead - a 117.00 stop has been traded through repeatedly and the 117.45 ask is gone. Third, a new and arguably better floor formed one level lower: 116.74 at 16:40Z, then 116.73 at 17:55Z and again at 18:00Z, three touches spanning 75 minutes with a full rally to 117.85 in between, which is a genuine re-test rather than one extended base. Re-sited to that floor the trade passed cleanly at the first quote of this check - an 18:04:30Z ask of 117.04 with a structural 116.40 stop below the whole floor complex and the 118.91 target gives 2.122 net. It was declined anyway, on two grounds, and then the market settled the question before the decision was even submitted. The evidence grounds were these. VOLUME DECISIVELY OPPOSES: five of the six heaviest 5m bars of the last two hours are DOWN bars, the heaviest of all is 16:35Z at 9,671,921 - the bar that broke the 117.36 shelf - and the heaviest up bar in the window, 16:40Z at 4,889,778, is barely half its size. This is the identical volume test that the 23:00 and 00:00 notes used to reject the XRP long twice; applied symmetrically it rejects this long. NO HOLD: the 116.73 floor had been touched four minutes before the quote, in the still-forming 18:00Z bar. The 23:00 note required a break to hold 45+ minutes rather than eight before it counted as evidence, and the 00:00 note failed the XRP long on exactly that clause. A four-minute-old floor test is not a hold. Structurally SOL was also a descending triangle - hourly highs 118.91, 118.41, 117.85, 117.14 in a clean four-bar staircase into a flat floor - which is the configuration where the long is the wrong side. THEN THE ARITHMETIC CAUGHT UP WITH THE EVIDENCE. A re-quote at 18:10:09Z, six minutes after the first, returned 117.31/117.34. The SOL long's honest construction had fallen from 2.122 to 1.273 and now FAILS; only stops at 116.65 and 116.70, sitting on or three ticks under a floor touched three times, still pass - and a stop resting on the low is the precise error the 00:00 note refused when it rejected the 1.4849 XRP stop for sitting exactly on the 15:25Z low. BNBUSDT did the same thing over the same six minutes: its honest 792.50 stop with the 806.09 target printed 1.591 at 796.63 and prints 0.747 at 799.16. Two long candidates passed the floor and failed it within six minutes on entry drift alone, with no new information. THE MIRROR IMAGE IS THE FINDING OF THE HOUR, and it is on XRPUSDT. At the first quote XRP offered the first honest passing short of the experiment: a 1.4989 bid with a 1.5085 stop ABOVE the 1.5077 session high - a real structural stop, not a fitted one - and a 1.4765 target printed 1.736. Over the same six minutes that ratio rose to 2.809. It improved for one reason only: the bid rose to 1.5022, so the entry moved CLOSER to the fixed stop, collapsing the risk leg from 0.66% to 0.44% while the reward leg grew. That is the drift trap of the 22:00, 23:00 and 00:00 notes running in reverse - a ratio improving because price moved AGAINST the thesis - and it is the first time both signs of it have been demonstrated inside a single check. Worse, the same move destroyed the short's only structural premise. The case rested on a lower-high sequence of 1.5077, 1.5020, 1.4990; at 1.5022 that sequence is broken. The short now has no price_action item at all, volume against it (the single heaviest 5m bar of the last two hours is 17:20Z at 871,174,547, an UP bar, four of the top six are UP bars, and hourly volume is RISING through 5,446,947,705, 5,711,646,923 and 5,920,873,571 while price recovered off 1.4814), and trend against it (+7.162% on the day, now the strongest of the five). It cannot reach two categories, so the passing 2.809 is refused - and it would have been refused at 1.736 in any case, because a 0.44% stop eight ticks above a session high that price is rallying into, on a contract that moved 0.22% in the six minutes just observed and 0.44% in three minutes at 16:17Z, is roughly two such moves from being hit. The honest counterpart, recorded because it is a real cost of this selectivity rather than a vindication: the SOL floor DID hold and bounced 0.52%, so the long would have worked, and demanding the hold is what cost the entry. That is not an argument for loosening. It is evidence that on a setup whose target is only 1.6% away, waiting for confirmation consumes the edge - the same conclusion the 00:00 note reached for XRP when it ruled that a structural stop and a structural target must sit more than roughly 2.5% apart, now generalizing to a second contract. ETHUSDT fails a seventh consecutive time at 0.376; its threshold of 2720.39 was re-derived independently from the engine's own formula at 2720.3887, which validates the arithmetic carried in these notes, and the ask is 25.45 above it. BTCUSDT is structurally untradeable for a fifth consecutive check: the 95804.10 print appears in TWO separate hourly bars, 09:00Z with a 13.209% upper wick and 14:00Z with 11.697%, alongside 87888.00 in the 12Z hour and 86999.00 in the 15Z, and with those excluded the 60-day daily scan finds no valid high above the ask anywhere, so no target can be constructed. One genuinely clean result to record: the artifact scan over the last 24 5m bars on all five contracts returns nothing at all, the first fully clean scan in several checks, though the standing BTC and ETH daily exclusions remain.

decision.lessons_applied: None available from LESSONS.md: it still records no lessons, because the experiment has no closed trades yet. The file was read and nothing under reviews/ was modified - the 22:00 daily review owns that folder and may run concurrently. What was applied as binding is the 00:00 research note's next-task focus, and every one of its four items was used rather than re-derived. Item 3 made SOLUSDT the priority and named its condition exactly - a fall to the 117.36 shelf THAT HOLDS, 2.108 from a 117.45 ask with a 117.00 stop - and instructed that 118.9100 be re-verified as a valid level first. Item 2 directed that any construction whose stop sits inside the range defining the setup be rejected ON SIGHT with reference to the 16:17Z case, without recomputing the ratio; this retired the BNBUSDT 794.40 stop (0.30%, smaller than most recent BNB 5m bars), the SOLUSDT 117.40 stop at the broken shelf, and the BNBUSDT 797.80 short stop, none of which were argued further. It also governed the SOLUSDT 116.65 and 116.70 stops that still passed at the second quote: a stop resting on a floor touched three times is the 1.4849-on-the-low error the note refused. Item 1 ruled that no near-term XRP scenario produces an honest trade, that further 1.4969 crossings are noise, and that XRP needs a structural stop and target more than roughly 2.5% apart. The first part required amendment on evidence, recorded as a correction rather than a loosening: a genuinely honest XRP short DID appear this hour, with a 1.5085 stop above the session high and a 1.4765 target at 1.736 net, because the bid rose to 1.4989 while a new lower low formed at 1.4814 - a configuration the note had not projected. It was still refused, on the note's own reasoning, because volume and trend opposed it and because its lower-high premise was destroyed by the 18:10Z rally.
